changeSet.sql: UPDATE surveillance_case c JOIN encounter e ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id SET c.notification_date = DATE_ADD(e.encounter_datetime, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) WHERE c.notification_date IS NOT NULL

UPDATE surveillance_case SET notification_date = (SELECT DATEADD('HOUR', 1, e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_id = surveillance_case.encounter_id) WHERE notification_date IS NOT NULL
